title: Computed cubic T2 genback assembly
objective: Replace the frozen x^3-200*x+7 signed-genback T2 candidate tape with source-transparent Sage.js rounded-T2 multiplication and exact PARI LLL scheduling for all five reductions
references: PARI 2.17.4 base4.c idealred0/idealpseudomin and lll.c ZM_lll

handoff.summary: Replaced the authenticated x^3-200*x+7 candidate input with an ordinary source-transparent implementation of scaled cubic ideal inversion, rounded-T2 basis multiplication, connected FLATTER/fast/DPE LLL selection, and the exact five-step signed-genback schedule. The composition derives [-3,-1] from the real Smith transform, records exact J/B/U/y witnesses, and reaches the established class assembly with no PARI candidate or factor runtime input. Pristine PARI 2.17.4, CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged results agree through h=24 and Ga/GD/ga.
risks: The surrounding scheduler deliberately admits only the frozen two-prime relation [-3,-1], although the single-candidate primitive is not answer-specific.
The connected LLL entry is full-rank degree three and rejects cases requiring its unported heuristic or proved precision fallbacks.
The rounded T2 matrix remains prepared input, and cubic scaled inversion retains the modulus-below-2^64 restriction.
The current transactional composition computes signed ideal arithmetic once to derive candidates and again inside the established assembly; fusion is a performance follow-up.
next_steps: Fuse computed candidate selection directly into generic signed idealpowred/genback to remove duplicate ideal arithmetic while retaining the same witness owners.
Generalize the computed scheduler beyond [-3,-1] and lift the degree-three and LLL fallback boundaries against new authenticated traces.
Connect prepared-field construction of nf_get_roundG so the rounded T2 matrix is no longer supplied at this boundary.
